verdict.rationale: Docs clearly describe an automated, smart-linked data room that ties cap table entries to underlying documents (grants, consents, financing docs) and is marketed as 'secured' — a core diligence-ready data room capability offered across pricing tiers. However, there is no explicit documentation of granular, role-based permissioning for external parties like counsel or investors (e.g. view-only access, watermarking, expiring links) — missing for 10: explicit external-party permission controls, evidence of investor/counsel-specific access workflows, and any hands-on/independent confirmation of the sharing experience.
